description: Wembley Stadium stands in London, England: a 90,000-capacity venue opened in 2007, home to England national team, FA Cup finals. The home of football; the arch is iconic. Stadiums are the cathedrals of sport — concrete memory banks where generations experienced the same joys and heartbreaks. title: History
d: Wembley Stadium opened in 2007. The home of football; the arch is iconic..

description: The history of Wembley Stadium begins in 2007. The home of football; the arch is iconic. Like all great grounds, it has been rebuilt, renamed, and reborn — stands rising where terraces stood, roofs arriving decades after the first kick. Its timeline is the timeline of its tenants' triumphs and the city's love affair with the game.

Renovations keep adding hospitality while trying not to dilute the soul.
